items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: Hannah Williams married Roger Wolfe Kahn the international banker's son.

ctx.x: My first wife was Dorothy Williams of the Williams' Sisters. They were singers and dancers. And they were very good the Williams' Sisters. They recorded and it was swinging, they were swinging. And her name was Dorothy Williams and we had a baby called Dorothy our daughter. And that was while I was in the show Buddy Rose's 'Crazy Quilt'. Dorothy and I were married, we had a baby and Hannah, her sister, went into Buddy Rose's 'Crazy Quilt' with Fanny Brice, Bill Baker, Ted Healy, James Barton, Georgie Jessel. And…

And we went along like that for about a year I guess and then the show went on the road. And Hannah, no before the show went on the road, Hannah Williams married Roger Wolfe Kahn the international banker's son. And she married Roger Wolfe Kahn and Dorothy, my wife, took her place in the show. For a while. But then the show went on the road and Dorothy didn't go. They got somebody else. She stayed in New York with the baby.

To take care of the baby and I went on the road with the show. And when I came back why she had gotten together with her sister and they were both, I mean Hannah was going to get a divorce from Roger Wolf Kahn and my wife decided to divorce me and marry somebody with a lot of money. And that broke me up. That's the thing that, that's the thing that broke me up.
